name: No-Knead Bread
source: Adapted from Jim Lahey / NYT 2006 (My Bread)
steps: Whisk flour, salt and yeast. Add water and stir to a shaggy, sticky dough.
Cover and rest at room temperature 12-18 h, until dotted with bubbles.
Scrape onto a floured surface, fold over twice, cover and rest 15 min.
Shape into a ball and proof seam-down on floured towel ~2 h.
Heat a covered Dutch oven at 230C/450F for 30 min.
Drop the dough in, cover, bake 30 min; uncover and bake 15-20 min more.
Cool completely on a rack before slicing.
notes: 75% hydration. Dough should be wet and sticky; weigh for consistency.
